description: This file defines the OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult> class, which manages invoking requests on grain references within the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles invocation stages, filters, and response processing.

classes.name: OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult>
classes.description: A class responsible for invoking a request on a grain reference, managing invocation stages, filters, and response handling within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: OutgoingCallInvoker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the invoker with grain reference, request, options, request sender, and filters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the invocation pipeline, handling filters and sending the request.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidCall
methods.description: Throws an exception if Invoke() is called more times than expected.

methods.name: ThrowBrokenCallFilterChain
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating a broken filter chain during invocation.
